bio.text: Caroline Shinkle is the Republican nominee for New York's 12th Congressional District, the Manhattan seat Rep. Jerrold Nadler is leaving; she is a corporate lawyer and a Midtown Manhattan resident.
She graduated from MIT with a degree in economics and later earned a law degree from Harvard.

Before running she held internships at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Israel and the Federal Reserve Board, and, as of March 2026, had spent five years at the law firm Cravath, Swaine & Moore.
This is her first run for public office.
